nec1ef07eb5.headline: Mitsubishi Group cooperates with Phuc Khang Corporation to develop green buildings
nec1ef07eb5.summary: Mitsubishi Group and Phuc Khang Corporation will invest $30 million in the Diamond Lotus Riverside project, focusing on green building development.
nec1ef07eb5.why: This partnership signals growth in sustainable construction in Vietnam, affecting local real estate and green investment sectors.
